overview_description.description: Legendary Entertainment is a media company that creates and distributes content for television and digital platforms around the world. Through a strategic partnership with other production studios, the company creates, develops, co-produces, co-finances, and distributes motion pictures dedicated to owning, producing, and delivering content to mainstream audiences with a targeted focus on the powerful fandom demographic. It owns, produces, and distributes box-office movies and films, television shows, and comic story lines.

about_short_description.short_description: Legendary Entertainment is an entertainment company focused on producing digital comics and television.

product.name: Legendary Pictures
product.description: A film production and financing division that develops, produces, owns, and delivers feature films, including adaptations and franchise-based entertainment.

product.name: Legendary Television and Digital Media
product.description: A television and digital media division that develops, produces, owns, and delivers scripted and unscripted entertainment for broadcast, cable, streaming, and digital platforms.

product.name: Legendary Comics
product.description: A comics publishing division that creates and publishes original graphic novels, comic books, and stories expanding Legendary’s film and television properties.

product.name: Nerdist
product.description: A digital media brand associated with Legendary that produces and distributes entertainment news, interviews, commentary, and fan-focused content.

product.name: Legendary Merchandise and Online Shop
product.description: An online commerce channel offering branded apparel, collectibles, publications, and other merchandise connected to Legendary properties and characters.

product.name: Street Fighter: Combo Challenge
product.description: A playable rhythm-style video game based on the Street Fighter film trailer, featuring timed combo-input challenges.
